name: Shikaku Academy
description: Shikaku Academy — a theme for an online certification academy for project-management and IT credentials. A cool grey ground with pale paper strips in hanada blue (#4E7A93) that hold the headlines beside a documentary photograph standing on the fold, numbered-tab course cards that step down 40 px each, a fan of three rotated photo cards beside the lesson player, and a single course, pathway bundle and all-access plan table. Libre Baskerville for headings, Work Sans for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll reveals respect reduced motion.

fonts.role: display: headlines, paper strips, card titles, numbers (variable 400-700, regular and italic)

summary.en: An online certification academy: paper-strip headlines, numbered-tab course cards in a descending ladder, a fan of rotated photo cards and a plan comparison table.
